device: Android phone (user's phone), Qualcomm Adreno-6xx class GPU

observation.raw: WebGPU output had transparent background but left some opaque rails on the image's main object; WASM output was a perfect transparent-background image.
observation.interpretation: WebGPU (adreno f16=yes) produced a visually defective mask (missing foreground -> opaque rails left on the subject); WASM produced a clean mask. On this Adreno device WebGPU is neither faster (6525 ms vs 6457 ms, ~1% apart) nor visually reliable, so WASM is the safe default; WebGPU stays an opt-in path.
